description: City of Yarra drainage pipes is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Yarra. This data asset has information of Yarra City Council's drain pipes which constitute part of the stormwater drainage network carrying water runoff to catchment areas or water bodies. Coverage: City of Yarra. The portal files it under the publisher City of Yarra. Its tags are drainpipes, ocd-drainpipes-0.2, opencouncildata. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-08-10 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
